objects.name: boat
objects.description: small fishing boat: red/pink hull with white upper stripe and the text "AH805" on its side, white wheelhouse/cabin, mast with cross-bar and rigging, black davit/post at the rear, white railings. Bow points left (toward image left), stern at right.
objects.motion: translates steadily to the image LEFT the whole clip (bow-stern midpoint x 416.5 -> 136.0 px, about -3.8 px/frame, fairly constant) and slightly UP in the image (hull bottom y 618 -> 605.5, mast top y 304 -> 313) while its apparent size shrinks (rigid scale of superstructure 1.000 -> 0.929; hull length 263 -> 228 px) => moving left AND away from the camera (depth grows ~7-8 % if scale ~ 1/depth). Hull length shrinks faster than the rigid scale, so the boat also yaws slightly (bow-stern line turning a little toward the viewing direction); the rigging lines swap side relative to the mast by the end. No start/stop within the clip; slight bobbing not detectable.
objects.reference_point: ref_x = midpoint of bow tip and stern extreme; ref_y = midpoint of mast top and hull bottom (full-boat bbox centre). Alternative hull_center_(x,y) = hull-only box centre. The Blender origin of a boat rig is unknown; it is most likely near the hull centre - choose per question.

objects.name: bird
objects.description: single dark-brown bird with broad wings, flying (flapping) left-to-right across the cliff face at roughly the height of the boat mast (y ~355-410). Only flying animal in the scene.
objects.motion: flies to the image RIGHT the whole time it is visible: centroid x 233 (f0) -> 953 (f66, leaving through the right edge); y oscillates gently 368-400 (dips to ~396 around f9-13, rises to ~372 at f24, ~369 at f50). Already in flight at frame 0 (no take-off/landing). Passes the boat mast around frames 10-14 (mask partly hidden by mast). Starts leaving the frame at f63 (bbox touches x=959), gone from f67 on.
objects.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y = centroid of the dark bird mask (visible centre); bbox_cx/cy also given
objects.apparent_size: roughly constant over the clip (no clear depth change): wingspan-like horizontal extent width_x_px ~ 21-56 px (median 39) depending on wing phase; mask major axis 31-56 px; height_y_px 6-32 px.
